source: The application's own docs/solution chapters (OWASP 2013 A1 to A10) and the code they point at; every line below was read in the checkout at the revision above.

issues.description: `findContainingName` concatenates the search string into a JPQL `LIKE` clause.
`findByLoginUnsafe` concatenates the login into the JPQL query.
The ping address is appended to a `/bin/bash -c` command string and executed with `Runtime.exec`.
Passwords are stored as an unsalted MD5 digest.
The password-reset key is the MD5 of the login, so anyone can derive it.
The search parameter is written into the page with a raw scriptlet.
The product name is rendered with `escape="false"`.
The profile update loads and saves the user by a caller-supplied `userId` without checking it belongs to the session.
`struts.devMode` is `true`, exposing debugging behaviour in production.
The database password is committed in the configuration file.
The admin user listing is gated by a client-supplied cookie `admin=1`.
The authentication stack carries no token interceptor, so state-changing actions accept forged requests.
Struts 2.3.30 (remote code execution advisories including S2-045), log4j 2.3, Spring 3.0.5.
The redirect action forwards to any `url` parameter that is not empty.
